# Discover France

> > Comprehensive French travel and cultural resource featuring online reservations, accommodations, and educational content about France's arts, culture, and tourism destinations.

Discover France (operated by The Wharton Group) provides travel booking services for hotels, apartments, and flights throughout France, alongside cultural and educational resources about French provinces, arts, and tourism. The site partners with major hotel chains including Best Western, Hilton, Holiday Inn, Ibis, Inter-Continental, and Campanile to offer comprehensive accommodation options.

## Key Topics

- France travel and tourism
- Online hotel reservations
- Apartment and studio rentals
- French culture and arts
- Paris airports (CDG, Orly, Beauvais)
- France provinces and regions
- Accommodation booking services
- The Wharton Group
- Hotel chains: Best Western, Hilton, Holiday Inn, Ibis, Inter-Continental, Campanile, Kyriad
- French cultural education
- Travel services and guides
- Aviation and air travel resources
- Tourism destinations in France

## Travel Booking & Reservations

- [France Online Travel Reservations](https://travelcenter.discoverfrance.net/): Main travel booking portal for France flights, hotels, cars & tours
- [Apartment and Studio Rentals in France](https://discoverfrance.net/Boutique/Travel/Apartments/index.shtml): France apartment & studio rental booking service for travelers
- [Discover France Travel Center - About Us](https://discoverfrance.net/Boutique/Travel/about_index.shtml): About DiscoverFrance.net travel services and hotel partners

## French Culture & Tourism

- [Discover France - French Arts, Culture, Tourism](https://discoverfrance.net/): Homepage covering French culture, arts, tourism & travel resources

## Travel Guides & Airport Information

- [Airports of Paris: Beauvais, CDG (Charles de Gaulle), Le Bourget, Orly](https://www.air-travel.discoverfrance.net/general_info.shtml): Guide to Paris airports: CDG, Orly, Beauvais & Le Bourget transport

## Reference Materials

- [Aviation Glossary, Dictionary of Aeronautical Terms (Part 1)](https://www.air-travel.discoverfrance.net/aviation_glossary.shtml): Aviation dictionary with 380+ aeronautical terms and abbreviations
